description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/synthetic.cpp. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the pack would export (for example implicit constructor and destructor calls are omitted), written to exercise the C1 cases; they are not a CodeQL recording. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'.

cases.virtual_dispatch: call_sites: dispatch -> h->handle(dst, src), two virtual_resolved candidates, line 25
cases.two_paths_to_one_sink: path_flows: argv (line 52) and getenv (line 55) both reach memcpy argument 2 at line 45
cases.dominating_guard: guards: len < 64 (line 33) dominates memcpy at line 34, true_branch
cases.non_dominating_guard: guards: len > 0 (line 42) does not control memcpy at line 45, which also has a none row
cases.unknown_range: ranges: memcpy len at line 45 has lower and upper unknown
cases.sign_changing_conversion: range_conversions: int -> size_t sign_change for memcpy len at lines 34 and 45
cases.unclassified_sink: sink_sites: send argument 1 at line 49, model RemoteFlowSinkFunction, which catalog.json does not classify
cases.macro_mapped_condition: guards: CHECK_LEN(len) at line 36, in_macro true, reported at the expansion site

raw_bqrs.bqrs/CallSites.info.json: hand-authored `codeql bqrs info --format=json` output for CallSites.bqrs
raw_bqrs.bqrs/call_sites.decoded.json: hand-authored `codeql bqrs decode --format=json --result-set call_sites` output in unsorted row order
